verdict.rationale: Qodo is an AI code review platform that generates insights and suggestions from the team's own code and PR data. Its findings explain what needs attention, why, and how to fix it, ranked by severity, with one-click apply. It also produces structured PR summaries, blast-radius risk classification, and relevance scores learned from past PR handling. Rule Miner derives standards from PR history, and users can chat with Qodo inside PRs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality (community comments mostly address other features), and only thin documentation of portal-level analytics such as codebase-health history and Software Map.
